body.p: When a person gets scared, his soul jumps out and he dies. There is a soul. You must take the buttons. When you sleep at night, three nights, then you leave them - the Evenkis probably say: "If you smother yourself, you will die". The Evenkis say that the earth stands on fish. The spirit of fire is a woman. You can't scold her - the fire. If she gets angry, you'll burn. There was a woman - she had two children. One [of them] was in a cradle. In the evening the boys were sitting by the fire and a spark flew into it. The spark flew and he was burned. The woman took a knife and stuck it into the fire. She went to bed. Her husband wasn't there, he was hunting. It was winter - frost. When she slept, she got up in the morning and the fire was out. She started to make a fire - she used a flint to make a fire, she tried, but she couldn't make a fire. The fire won't light. She can't make fire - the fire doesn't burn. She put her children on a sledge and went to her husband and carried them away. She came to her husband, to the sleeping place, and said: "I can't light the fire!" They spent the night in the place where they slept. In the morning they returned to their home. They walked in the evening, it was far, they came home at night. He saw sparks burning in the yurt by the fireplace [hearth]. Fire burns in the yurt's fireplace. Where the woman [fire spirit] sits, [from there] she says: "I kissed your child! You stab me with a knife? Now I've cut! Give your son to me!" They went to bed in the evening. In the morning they got up - the woman was gone and her son was gone.
